The shared theorem and displayed estimate do not establish recognition of the missing p range.

ISSUE-003 identifies that the scale-free least-squares bound fails under rescaling because it omits the function or solution amplitude, and supplies the corresponding norm and B corrections for both the auxiliary theorem and diffusion corollary. This is the same missing amplitude dependence diagnosed by the gold issue.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: Both entries diagnose that the approximation error bound is incorrectly independent of the size of the approximated function or initial condition; scaling the input scales the error, so the bound requires the extension norm or the corresponding diffusion amplitude factor.
